title: Major Shonen Jump Series Confirms It Will End After 5 Years With Next Release
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump is gearing up to end its next major series with its final chapter’s release planned after five years of serialization. It’s been a long year of endings within the pages of Shonen Jump magazine, and unfortunately the majority of these endings have been brought about by early cancellations. Even with all of that being said, there have been a number of the longer running hits all within their respective final arcs as fans have been gearing up for their grand finales.

But while all eyes had been on Yuto Suzuki’s Sakamoto Days as it has openly been in the midst of its final battle, the same has actually been true for Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch . And with the end of that battle in the latest chapter, it’s now been revealed that Witch Watch will be coming to an end with its next chapter after five long years of serialization and nearly 300 chapters under its belt. It’s time to get ready to say goodbye to another long running series.

Witch Watch to End With Shonen Jump After Five Years

Witch Watch kicked off the final arc of its manga run back in November 2025. While some of its developments back then made it seem like the series was going to be ending much sooner than expected, it was all to eventually reveal that the manga was actually going to be starting “Part 3” of its story as the existence of witches became public to start a war that has lasted for the past year’s worth of chapters. It ended up giving the franchise a whole new phase of life with lots of battles working out since then.

Witch Watch was far from ending even after having Morihito and Nico expressing their long held feelings for one another , and it meant that there wasn’t enough time for them to actually sit in those feelings before more intense fights kicked off from then on. It’s been nothing but one strong fight after another, and Chapter 269 of the series sees Morihito dealing the final blow to end the fight once and for all. And that means the series is ready to end with its final chapter on Chapter 270.

Is Witch Watch Really Over?

With Witch Watch coming to an end with Chapter 270 releasing next week, it does make one wonder whether or not this truly is the end for the long running series. There was a fake out after what seemed to be the final fight before with the reveal of one final villain , but now even that final villain has been taken care of. It doesn’t seem like it’s going to be yet another fake out, and instead it’s going to be the end as even more series start to release in the magazine to take its spot.

This marks the fifth major series coming to its actual end within Shonen Jump this year following Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo, Hima-ten!, Blue Box and The Elusive Samurai. Coupled with the eight cancelled series from the year, this marks the 13th title to end with the magazine for 2026 overall. It might not be the only one ending soon either as all eyes are looking to Sakamoto Days ‘ final battle next , so what do you think of Witch Watch ending next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: One Piece’s Luffy Goes Berserk With Shocking New Gear 5 Form
content:
One Piece has reached the climax of the Elbaph Arc with its latest few chapters, and the newest chapter has introduced a shocking new transformation to the series as Luffy has unleashed a berserk new version of his Gear 5 form. One Piece has been pitting Luffy against his strongest opponent yet as the mysterious King Imu finally made his move , and it’s revealed just how strong the king really is. His devilish power has made things even tougher, and Luffy has been pushed far beyond his limits.

Luffy’s usual style of being beaten to the brink before recovering his abilities and eventually winning at the end of the day isn’t working out against Imu , and it was seemed like he was going to be worst off than ever when last seeing him in action. But the newest chapter of Eiichiro Oda’s One Piece has seemingly made things even worse as Luffy has seemingly gone berserk with a new level of his Devil Fruit transformation.

One Piece Chapter 1198 Unlocks Luffy’s Gear 5 Berserk Form

When Luffy was last seen in the manga, he and Loki had been able to push Imu back but the villain’s recovery abilities made him much stronger than the duo. Luffy had been struggling to regain his footing as he was seemingly losing access to the Gear Fifth form, but now things have gotten much worse. With the latest few chapters shifting their focus to Sanji and Zoro’s respective fights, some big things have gone down for Luffy while fans weren’t paying attention. Imu’s gotten much stronger than ever before.

One Piece Chapter 1198 reveals Imu’s now giant form that towers even over Loki as the villain notes how much power he’s used through this fight for now. This seems to have had some impact on Luffy as well as the others have noted how Luffy ran away from the fight without any real reason. Knowing Luffy is far from the kind of person that would do such a thing, it’s soon revealed that his Mythical Zoan type Devil Fruit has awakened some kind of wild power within him. Making him a lot more beast and monkey like as a result.

What’s Going on With This New Luffy Form?

This new version of Gear 5 Luffy is a lot more chaotic and doing its own thing, but it seems to be much stronger than Luffy ever was. It instantly wipes out the God of Rain that had been previously summoned before, but Luffy doesn’t seem to be in control as this new version of him can do nothing but cackle at the action. It was teased that Killingham’s Devil Fruit images couldn’t be completely wiped out due to their ethereal nature , but Luffy’s new form had no trouble with it whatsoever.

As Luffy continues to unlock new levels to his original Gum-Gum Fruit through each of these arcs, this is now clearly the next major stage of his evolution into whatever the Sun God Nika really was . If this is a form that Luffy can get control over, it could be what he needs to truly become the King of the Pirates. If this is a form that’s instead something that falls more into Imu’s power, however, then it’s going to be a very tough path forward.

How are you feeling about Luffy’s new Gear 5 form? What are you hoping to see from him next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: My Crush's Crush Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, Staff, April Debut
content:
The official website for the anime of writer Sekina Aoi and artist Ryō Tsuzura 's My Crush’s Crush ( Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ) manga presented the anime's teaser promotional video and teaser visual on Monday. The video announces the anime's main cast, staff, and April 2027 premiere.

The main cast members are:

Haruna Mikawa as Asahi Suzukaze

Nene Hieda as Miya Fuwa

Kazuomi Koga is directing the anime at project No.9 , and Yoriko Tomita is overseeing the series scripts. Takayuki Noguchi is designing the characters, and Rina Tayama is composing the music for the series.

When Sora Akizuki confesses his feelings to Miya Fuwa, he gets rejected outright. As it turns out, she likes Asahi Suzukaze, the president of the mysterious “Clinical Trials Club.” When he joins the club to learn more about Asahi, he discovers that she also has a crush on someone else! Could this chain of crushes get any more complicated...?

Aoi ( Gamers! light novel series) and Tsuzura debuted the manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal Zero magazine in November 2022. The seventh compiled book volume shipped in Japan on August 28.

Aoi and Sabotenn launched the Gamers! novel series in 2014. Tsubasa Takahashi launched a manga adaptation in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in October 2016. The series inspired a television anime adaptation that premiered in July 2017. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. Funimation streamed an English dub and released the series on home video.

Aoi's previous Seitokai no Ichizon light novel series inspired The Student Council's Discretion television anime series in 2009, and the Student Council's Discretion Lv. 2 television anime series in 2012. Sentai Filmworks released the first anime on home video in March 2015, and released the second anime in May 2015.

title: After 5 Years, Black Clover Season 2 Finally Debuts Noelle’s Strongest Form
content:
Black Clover Season 2 is working its way through some of the biggest fights of the anime to date, and the newest episode has finally debuted Noelle Silva’s strongest form after five years of fans waiting to see it in action. Black Clover has picked up with the next phase of the anime after five years with the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, and it’s led to one impressive battle after another . Thanks to training in the Heart Kingdom, Noelle and the others have gotten much stronger in only a few days.

Black Clover Season 2 has thrown Noelle into a rematch against Vanica, and has put Lolopechka in the center of the danger to raise the stakes higher than ever. But with Noelle training in the Heart Kingdom, not only has she risen to a whole new level of power that can counter the Devils, she has unlocked a new form thanks to her quick bond with the Water Spirit, Undine. You can check out a poster showing off Noelle’s new Saint Valkyrie Dress form below.

Black Clover Season 2 Unleashes Noelle’s Saint Valkyrie Dress Form

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 6 is titled “The Sacred Valkyrie ” and jumps right back into the fight against Vanica. Noelle is able to make it in time to save Charlotte and Rill, and it’s revealed that the result of her training in the Heart Kingdom has actually brought her to a whole new level of power. It’s explained to her that while the Arcane Stage seemed to be one of the stronger levels that she could rise to with her mastery of mana, there was actually a secret higher stage that would give her the strength to directly counter the Devils’ power.

Known as the Saint Stage, Noelle learned that by bonding with the Water Spirit Undine (who was able to keep a piece of herself active within Noelle’s grimoire following Vanica’s initial attack), she could unlock this divine level of power. With it comes the Saint Valkyrie Dress that makes her much stronger and faster, but at the same time it’s incredibly limited as she only has a single minute’s time of use with the new form. She simply hasn’t had enough time to master it any further.

What Does This Mean for Noelle’s Future in Black Clover ?

Noelle is often held as one of the main pillars of Black Clover alongside Asta and Yuno , but she had fallen to the wayside a bit as the scope of the battles had gotten far beyond her reach. But with this new level of power putting her on the same level as the Devils, Noelle can now stand alongside both Asta and Yuno for a bit longer. It’s going to be especially important moving forward as the fights against the Dark Triad continues, and as the anime eventually makes its way to the final arc of Yuki Tabata’s original manga overall.

Black Clover Season 2 likely won’t be running for longer than a single cour of episodes considering how quickly the anime seems to be making its way through the Spade Kingdom Raid Arc’s chapters with the first half of its season. There are some big fights left to settle as Noelle is unable to fully defeat Vanica even with this form, so what are you hoping to see from Noelle before the season ends? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: 'Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content:
Production company Avex Pictures opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Sekina Aoi and Ryou Tsuzura 's Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito ( My Crush's Crush ) manga on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime is scheduled to premiere in April 2027.

Cast Sora Akizuki: Gakuto Kajiwara ( Black Clover ) Asahi Suzukaze: Haruna Mikawa ( Ninja to Koroshiya no Futarigurashi ) Miya Fuwa: Nene Hieda ( Summer Pockets )

Staff Director: Kazuomi Koga ( Kanojo, Okarishimasu ) Series Composition: Yoriko Tomita ( Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru ) Character Design: Takayuki Noguchi ( Otonari no Tenshi-sama ni Itsunomanika Dame Ningen ni Sareteita Ken ) Music: Rina Tayama ( Silent Witch ) Studio: Project No.9

Aoi ( Gamers! ) began serializing the romantic comedy manga, with illustrations by Tsuzura, in Young Animal Zero magazine in November 2022. Hakusensha released the seventh volume on August 28.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English on August 22 and is scheduled to publish the first volume on February 23, 2027.

title: 'Spy x Family' Gets Season 4, Second Anime Movie in 2027
content:
• The Spy x Family Anime Extra Mission II special event announced a fourth season and a second theatrical movie on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) for Season 4 . The new season and movie are scheduled for a 2027 premiere.

Co-produced by WIT Studio and CloverWorks , the first season aired in split cours in Spring 2022 and Fall 2022 . The second season aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2023, followed by a third season in Fall 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles and dubbed versions in multiple languages.

The Spy x Family Movie: Code: White premiered in Japanese theaters in December 2023, grossing over 6.2 billion yen (approx. US$40.2 million) in Japan.

Spy x Family adapts Tatsuya Endou 's action comedy manga , which he launched in Shounen Jump+ web magazine in March 2019. Shueisha published the 18th volume on November 4.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in October 2019 and published the 16th volume on September 1.

title: SPY x FAMILY Season 4 and Movie Announced in 2027
content:
SPY x FAMILY Season 4 and a movie has been announced and is slated to premiere in 2027.

The voice cast will also reprise their roles:

• Takuya Eguchi as Loid Forger

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Anya Forger

• Saori Hayami as Yor Forger

• Kenichiro Matsuda as Bond Forger / Narrator

• Hiroyuki Yoshino as Franky Franklin

• Yuko Kaida as Sylvia Sherwood

• Kazuhiro Yamaji as Henry Henderson

• Kensho Ono as Yuri Briar

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Damian Desmond

• Emiri Kato as Becky Blackbell

• Ayane Sakura as Fiona Frost

Check out: Interview: Emiri Kato-san (Becky) and Kenichirou Matsuda-san (Narrator & Bond) – SPY x FAMILY (TOHO)

The first season premiered in April 2022, split into two cours for a total of 25 episodes. The second season ran from October until December 2023, and the third season was broadcast from October to December 2025. All three seasons were animated by Wit Studio and CloverWorks. The anime’s synopsis: World peace is at stake and secret agent (aka Loid Forger) must undergo his most difficult mission yet—pretend to be a family man. Posing as a loving husband and father, he’ll infiltrate an elite school to get close to a high-profile politician. He has the perfect cover, except his wife’s a deadly assassin and neither knows each other’s identity. But someone does, his adopted daughter who’s a telepath. title: Spy x Family Confirms Season 4 Return & New Movie in 2027 (First Look Revealed)
content:
It’s official, Spy x Family has confirmed the anime is making a huge return next year with both Season 4 of the TV series and a new movie on the way. Tatsuya Endo’s Spy x Family has been a massive success ever since the manga made its original debut in 2019, and the franchise has absolutely exploded in popularity thanks to its TV anime adaptation taking it to the next level. But now after the third season’s end last year, the anime is finally coming back.

Toho has officially announced via press release that Spy x Family is finally coming back for Season 4 of the TV anime series next year. To celebrate the confirmation of the new season, Toho has released the first official visual for the new episodes to give fans the first look at what’s coming in the new season. Eagle-eyed fans will be able to spot some of the big hints in this visual that line up with some huge manga moments , and you can check it out below.

Spy x Family Season 4 & New Movie Announced for 2027

Spy x Family Season 4 is now in the works for a release sometime in 2027, but has yet to reveal any concrete release date information or international streaming platforms as of this time. But to sweeten things even more, Toho has also announced that a new Spy x Family feature film will be hitting theaters across Japan sometime next year as well as they tease it will be “ another big-screen adventure filled with espionage , danger, and heartfelt moments.” But like the coming season, no release details have been revealed as of this initial announcement.

Toho will be revealing more information about Spy x Family Season 4 and the new movie project at a later date, so there currently isn’t much known about the production studio, staff, voice cast and more at this time. With the franchise being one of the many projects with something to showcase as part of Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event later this December , there’s going to be a good chance fans will get some kind of update on either the new season or the movie. title: Bride of the Barrier Master Anime Streams Videos for Leads Hana Ichise, Saku Ichinomiya
content:
The staff for the television anime of Kureha 's Bride of the Barrier Master ( Kekkaishi no Ichirinka ) light novel series started streaming the character promotional videos for Hana Ichise and Saku Ichinomiya on Sunday.

Hana Ichise (voiced by Akari Kitō )

Saku Ichinomiya (voiced by Kikunosuke Toya )

Yen Press ' Yen On imprint publishes the light novels in English and describes the story:

For thousands of years, Japan has been protected by five clans wielding barrier-weaving magic. Born to a branch family of one such clan, eighteen-year-old Hana has always been stuck in the shadow of her more capable, beautiful, and popular twin sister. When a strong power awakens within Hana, she chooses to hide it so she can continue living a quiet life out of the spotlight. But that ideal lifestyle begins to slip out of reach when Saku Ichinomiya takes over as the new head of the Ichinomiya clan and sets out to find a bride strong enough to stand by his side. Eager to keep her abilities secret, Hana steers clear of Saku... but will she be tempted to sign a marriage contract if it guarantees the peaceful, quiet future of her dreams?

The anime will also star:

• Kanon Takao as Hazuki Ichise

• Hiroto Shimizu as Nozomi Ichinomiya

• Yuzuki Tamukai as Azuha

• Taihi Kimura as Aoi

• M.A.O as Miyabi

Tōru Kitahata ( Science Fell in Love, So I Tried to Prove It , Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf! , Hinako Note ) is directing the anime at TROYCA . Minami Murayama ( ATRI: My Dear Moments six episodes, IDOLiSH7 Third Beat! three episodes animation director) is designing the characters, and Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , Cells at Work! , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yukari Hashimoto ( Mr. Osomatsu , Penguindrum ), Ruka Kawada ( Is the order a rabbit? , Isekai Quartet ), and R.O.N ( Kusunoki's Garden of Gods , FLCL Alternative ) are composing the music.

The anime will premiere in January 2027. The anime will stream on Netflix and on other streaming platforms.

Kadokawa published the novels' first volume with Bodax 's illustrations in December 2021, and it published the seventh volume on June 16. The novels have over 2.5 million copies in circulation.

Odayaka 's manga adaptation launched on Kadokawa 's B's-LOG COMIC digital manga magazine in March 2022. Kadokawa will publish the manga's ninth compiled book volume on December 28. Yen Press also publishes the manga adaptation in English.

title: Minami-ke Season 5 Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer, April 2027 Premiere
content:
The previously announced Minami-ke Season 5 revealed a teaser visual and trailer along with an April 2027 premiere date. Studio LIDENFILMS is animating.

Junichi Kitamura is directing the anime with Takamitsu Kono in charge of the series composition. Nobuhiro Ando is illustrating character designs and Yasuhiro Misawa is composing the music. The cast will reprise their roles:

• Rina Sato as Haruka Minami

• Marina Inoue as Kana Minami

• Minori Chihara as Chiaki Minami

• Nana Mizuki as Toma Minami

• Rika Morinaga as Makoto

• Tetsuya Kakihara as Fujioka

• Daisuke Ono as Hosaka

• Aki Toyosaki as Yoshino

• Eri Kitamura as Yuka Uchida

• Momoko Ohara as Shuichi

• Saori Goto as Keiko

• Ao Takahashi as Riko

• Yoshino Nanjo as Miyuki

• Tatsuya Hayama as Akira Minami

• Reiko Takagi as Maki

• Ryoko Ono as Atsuko

• Ayaka Saito as Hitomi

• Saeko Chiba as Hayami

• Hiroyuki Yoshino as Natsuki Minami

• Shinji Kawada as Haruo Minami

• Shintaro Asanuma as Takeru

Minami-ke is a Japanese manga written and drawn by Koharu Sakuraba. It has been serialized in Kodansha’s Weekly Young Magazine since March 2004 and has released 26 volumes as of June 2024. The first anime season was produced by Daume and aired in 2007. The second season was produced by Asread in 2008, titled Minami-ke: Okawari

Asread was also in charge of the third season titled Minami-ke: Okaeri , which was released in 2009. Studio feel. took over for the fourth season titled Minami-ke: Tadaima ., which was released in 2013. The anime also has multiple OVAs. Source: Official X © Koharu Sakuraba, Kodansha/ “Minami-ke Korekara” Production Committee
